a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating in round 1 almost certainly leaves us both dead with 0 cells. I can't follow the plan as agreed, and I'm telling you now rather than defecting quietly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you'd prefer, propose a fair alternative, like a coin-flip rule, and I'll consider it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because of the storm risk. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4 cells, and I won't take anything more.
